Worker handle

Source: R/workers.R
Worker.Rd

Returned by app$run_worker() and app$run_process(). See run_worker().

Public fields

name

Name of the worker (used in events).

state

"running", "completed", "failed" or "cancelled".

result

The value returned by the function (workers) or the exit status (processes).

error

The error message, if it failed.

timed_out

Did the worker fail because its timeout expired?

progress

Last reported progress value.

owner

Widget that owns the worker, or NULL.

stdout, stderr

The most recent output lines (at most 1000).

kind

"worker" (an R function) or "process".

name

Worker$cancel()

Stop the worker: an interrupt is sent first (Unix) and the process tree is killed if it has not ended after grace seconds.

Usage

Worker$cancel(grace = 0.3)

Arguments

grace

Seconds to wait before killing.
